scope: Four thirty-second phases; same release engine, conservative offscreen building rejection.
decision: Keep conservative omission of offscreen work; sustained throughput remains unaccepted. These separate runs do not show a consistent overall speed win.
limits: Panning camera paths vary with pointer-call timing, so separately sampled pans are not identical workloads.
Fixed-view same-page PNG parity is proven separately for six cases; moving-camera pixel parity remains unverified.
No total memory/storage or physical-display pacing acceptance.
